transition_notes.dependency_rule: completed satisfies dependencies; only the two explicit branch exceptions below permit skipped; failed never satisfies a dependency
transition_notes.explicit_deep_read: assess=skipped with explicit user reason satisfies deepen dependency; deepen still required
transition_notes.coarse: assess completed and level<3; deepen/integrate/index_candidate/review skipped with coarse reason satisfies coarse finalize only; lead finalizes coarse note and README, index_published=null because deep index is not applicable; links_verified and evidence_archived still required
transition_notes.failure: record failed attempt; downstream pending; do not retry automatically
transition_notes.changed_input: retain old receipt; reset affected downstream stages to pending and record invalidation reason
transition_notes.review_changed_notes: accepted=false until final notes are covered by a new review or documented nonsemantic edit check
